steps.name: monorepo-root
steps.summary: 루트: package.json(name social-media-fullstack, workspaces apps/*·packages/*, packageManager bun@1.3.14, scripts build/lint/typecheck/test/dev=turbo run <task>, check=biome check ., format=biome check --write .; devDeps turbo ^2.10.13·@biomejs/biome 2.5.13·@social/biome-config workspace:*; trustedDependencies 없음), bunfig.toml([install] linker=hoisted), turbo.json(build ^build→dist/**·inputs $TURBO_DEFAULT$+.env*; lint/typecheck/test ^build; dev cache:false persistent; globalEnv EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL·DATABASE_URL·PORT·NODE_ENV), biome.json(extends @social/biome-config/biome, vcs.useIgnoreFile, files.includes에 dist/.expo/coverage/expo-env.d.ts/.turbo를 !!로 강제 제외, apps/api/** override useImportType off), bun.lock(텍스트, 커밋), .gitignore(node_modules/dist/coverage/.turbo/.expo/expo-env.d.ts/.env*·!.env.example/.DS_Store 추가), AGENTS.md(실체)+CLAUDE.md(한 줄 포인터). packages/typescript-config: @social/typescript-config, base.json = strict·skipLibCheck·esModuleInterop·isolatedModules·forceConsistentCasingInFileNames·resolveJsonModule·noUncheckedIndexedAccess만 — 소비 패키지는 `extends: "@social/typescript-config/base.json"` 후 module/moduleResolution/target/types/rootDir/outDir를 직접 명시, baseUrl 금지. packages/biome-config: @social/biome-config, exports {"./biome": "./base.json"} (space 2·lineWidth 100·single quote·semicolons·trailingCommas all·unsafeParameterDecoratorsEnabled·rules.preset recommended·organizeImports on). 다음 step 제약: 각 패키지는 typescript ~6.0.3 devDependency 선언, lint 스크립트는 `biome check .`, 내부 패키지는 type:module + tsc→dist ESM, 루트 biome.json이 전체를 검사하므로 하위에 biome.json 두지 않음, `bunx biome`는 루트 devDeps 설치 후에만 사용, apps/*·packages/*에 새 파일을 만들면 `bun run check`가 즉시 대상에 넣는다(포맷은 bun run format으로 맞출 것).

steps.name: schemas-package
steps.summary: packages/schemas(@social/schemas 0.0.0, private, type:module): exports {".": {types ./dist/index.d.ts, default ./dist/index.js}, "./package.json"}, main/types→dist, files [dist]; scripts build=tsc -p tsconfig.build.json · typecheck=tsc --noEmit · lint=biome check . · test=bun test · dev=tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --watch; deps zod ^4.6.5(설치 4.6.5)만, devDeps typescript ~6.0.3 · @types/bun latest(1.4.2) · @social/typescript-config workspace:*. tsconfig.json(extends base, module/moduleResolution nodenext, target ES2023, types ["bun"], declaration+declarationMap, noEmit, include src) / tsconfig.build.json(extends ./tsconfig.json, noEmit false, rootDir ./src, outDir ./dist, types [], exclude src/**/*.test.ts). src/health.schema.ts: HealthCheckSchema = z.object({name: string.min(1), status: enum ok|fail, latencyMs?: number.nonnegative}), HealthResponseSchema = z.object({status: enum ok|degraded, timestamp: z.iso.datetime() (UTC Z 접미사 필수, 오프셋 불허), checks: HealthCheckSchema[]}), type HealthCheck / HealthResponse = z.infer. src/index.ts는 export * from './health.schema.js'. src/health.schema.test.ts(bun:test, 5 케이스). AGENTS.md(역할·구조·명령·새 Schema 절차·소비 규칙)+CLAUDE.md 한 줄 포인터. dist는 gitignore(미커밋); bun.lock 갱신됨. 다음 step 제약: 소비자는 @social/schemas를 workspace:*로 의존하고 dist만 import(소스 경로·paths 금지), `bun run --filter <소비자>` 단독 실행 전 `bun run --filter @social/schemas build` 선행; 모바일은 zod 직접 import 금지; API DTO는 `implements HealthResponse`/`HealthCheck`; timestamp는 `new Date().toISOString()` 형식이어야 parse 통과; 루트 `bun run check`가 packages/schemas를 이미 검사한다.
steps.capture_candidate: bun:test의 expect(actual).toEqual(expected)는 Jest(expected: any)와 달리 expected가 actual의 타입 T로 강타이핑되어, zod enum 필드를 가진 untyped 객체 리터럴 픽스처(status: 'ok' → string으로 확장)를 넘기면 tsc --noEmit에서 TS2769로 실패한다 (bun test 런타임은 통과) — 픽스처에 `satisfies z.infer<typeof Schema>`를 붙여 리터럴 좁힘을 유지하면 해결.

steps.name: api-app
steps.summary: apps/api(@social/api 0.0.1, private, type:module, NestJS 12.0.3 ESM + Vitest 4.1.11/Vite 8.3.0): scripts build=nest build · dev=nest start --watch · typecheck=tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json · lint=biome check . · test=vitest run · test:e2e=vitest run --config ./vitest.config.e2e.ts · db:ensure=sh scripts/ensure-db.sh (+템플릿 start/start:dev/start:prod/test:watch/test:cov/test:debug 유지); deps @nestjs/common·core·platform-express ^12.0.1, @nestjs/config ^12, @nestjs/cqrs ^12, drizzle-orm ~0.45.2, postgres ^3.4.9, class-validator ^0.15.1, class-transformer ^0.5.1, zod ^4.6.5, @social/schemas workspace:*; devDeps @nestjs/cli·schematics ^12, @nestjs/testing, drizzle-kit ~0.31.10, typescript ~6.0.3, @social/typescript-config workspace:*, @types/node ^24, @types/express, supertest+@types/supertest, vitest, @vitest/coverage-v8, vite-tsconfig-paths. package.json imports {#shared/*: ./dist/shared/*, #health/*: ./dist/health/*}; tsconfig.json(extends @social/typescript-config/base.json + 템플릿 값: nodenext, ES2023, emitDecoratorMetadata/experimentalDecorators, strictPropertyInitialization false, types [vitest/globals, node], rootDir ., outDir ./dist, incremental) + paths {#shared/*: ./src/shared/*, #health/*: ./src/health/*}, baseUrl 없음; tsconfig.build.json(rootDir ./src, exclude test·*spec.ts); nest-cli.json·vitest.config.ts·vitest.config.e2e.ts는 템플릿(vite-tsconfig-paths). src/shared/infrastructure/config/env.schema.ts: EnvSchema=z.object({DATABASE_URL: z.url(), PORT: z.coerce.number().int().positive().default(3000)}), type Env, validateEnv(config: Record<string, unknown>): Env(parse, 실패 throw). src/shared/infrastructure/database/drizzle/drizzle.module.ts: export const DRIZZLE=Symbol('DRIZZLE'); DrizzleService(ConfigService<Env,true> 주입, postgres(url,{max:5}) + drizzle(client), get db(): PostgresJsDatabase, onModuleDestroy→client.end({timeout:5})); @Global DrizzleModule providers [DrizzleService, {provide: DRIZZLE, useFactory: svc=>svc.db, inject:[DrizzleService]}] exports [DRIZZLE, DrizzleService]. schema/index.ts는 export {} placeholder; drizzle.config.ts(dialect postgresql, schema→그 index.ts, out ./drizzle, dbCredentials.url=process.env.DATABASE_URL ?? ''). shared/domain·shared/infrastructure/filters는 README.md 한 줄 자리 표시. src/health: application/ports/database-ping.port.ts(DATABASE_PING=Symbol, type DatabasePingResult={ok:true;latencyMs}|{ok:false;latencyMs;reason}, interface DatabasePingPort{ping(): Promise<DatabasePingResult>}); application/queries/get-health.query.ts(interface HealthReport{status:'ok'|'degraded'; timestamp:string; checks: ReadonlyArray<{name;status:'ok'|'fail';latencyMs:number}>}, class GetHealthQuery extends Query<HealthReport>); queries/handlers/get-health.handler.ts(@QueryHandler(GetHealthQuery) GetHealthHandler implements IQueryHandler<GetHealthQuery>, @Inject(DATABASE_PING) import type DatabasePingPort, execute(): Promise<HealthReport> — checks=[{name:'database',…}], fail 하나면 degraded, timestamp=new Date().toISOString()); handlers/index.ts export const QueryHandlers=[GetHealthHandler]; infrastructure/adapters/drizzle-database-ping.adapter.ts(@Inject(DRIZZLE) db: PostgresJsDatabase, db.execute(sql`select 1`) performance.now() 측정, 예외 catch→{ok:false, reason}); presentation/dtos/health-response.dto.ts(HealthCheckDto implements HealthCheck: @IsString name, @IsIn status, @IsOptional @IsNumber latencyMs?; HealthResponseDto implements HealthResponse: @IsIn status, @IsISO8601 timestamp, @ValidateNested({each:true}) @Type(()=>HealthCheckDto) checks: HealthCheckDto[], static fromReport(report: HealthReport)); presentation/health.controller.ts(@Controller('health') QueryBus만 주입, @Get() getHealth(@Res({passthrough:true}) res: express Response) → queryBus.execute(new GetHealthQuery()) → fromReport, degraded면 res.status(503), body는 항상 {status,timestamp,checks[]}); health.module.ts(controllers [HealthController], providers [...QueryHandlers, {provide: DATABASE_PING, useClass: DrizzleDatabasePingAdapter}]). src/app.module.ts imports [ConfigModule.forRoot({isGlobal:true, validate: validateEnv}), CqrsModule.forRoot(), DrizzleModule, HealthModule] — #health/·#shared/ 별칭으로 import(dist 스모크가 두 별칭 모두 검증). src/main.ts: NestFactory.create → useGlobalPipes(ValidationPipe{whitelist, forbidNonWhitelisted, transform}) → enableShutdownHooks → listen(ConfigService PORT). 테스트: src/health/application/queries/handlers/get-health.handler.spec.ts(ok/degraded 2건), src/shared/infrastructure/config/env.schema.spec.ts(PORT 기본값·DATABASE_URL 누락/형식오류 throw 2건), test/health.e2e-spec.ts(실 DB 200 + HealthResponseSchema.parse + checks[0].name==='database'; overrideProvider(DATABASE_PING) 실패 mock → 503 + degraded + checks[0].status fail; afterAll app.close()로 hang 없이 종료). .env.example/.env(DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/social_media, PORT=3000; .env는 gitignore, 커밋 안 함), scripts/ensure-db.sh(docker start postgres || true → pg_isready 대기 → pg_database 존재 검사 후 CREATE DATABASE social_media, 멱등 확인됨), AGENTS.md(구조·레이어 규칙·새 슬라이스 절차·명령·환경·ESM 규칙·503 정책·테스트)+CLAUDE.md 한 줄 포인터. 루트 .gitignore에 *.tsbuildinfo 추가(nest build가 apps/api/tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo를 앱 루트에 생성). bun.lock 갱신. 다음 step 제약: GET /health 계약은 @social/schemas HealthResponse 그대로(200 ok / 503 degraded, body 동일, latencyMs는 소수 ms) — 모바일은 503도 body를 파싱해야 함; API 기동은 apps/api에 .env가 있어야 하고 `bun run --filter @social/schemas build && bun run --filter @social/api db:ensure && bun run --filter @social/api dev`(기본 PORT 3000, EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3000 기준); 새 슬라이스는 tsconfig paths·package.json imports 두 곳에 #{domain}/* 추가; 데코레이터 시그니처의 인터페이스/타입은 import type(값 import는 TS1272); ESM 서브패스는 확장자 필요(supertest/types 같은 확장자 없는 서브패스는 TS2307); 루트 bun run check가 apps/api를 이미 검사한다(apps/api/**는 useImportType off).
steps.capture_candidate: ADR·컨벤션은 'tsc는 emit된 JS의 tsconfig paths 별칭을 재작성하지 않아 package.json imports 없이는 node dist가 죽는다'고 예상했지만, 실제 Nest CLI 12의 `nest build`(tsc 빌더)는 내장 tsconfig-paths 훅으로 `#shared/x.js` 같은 `.js` 확장자 별칭까지 상대경로로 재작성해 dist가 imports 없이도 동작했고, plain `tsc -p tsconfig.build.json`만 별칭을 그대로 남겼다 — 두 빌드 경로가 다르게 동작하므로 Node 서브패스 imports를 함께 두어 빌더 무관하게 런타임 해석을 보장하는 것이 안전하다.
